scientific_objective: Construct a statistically valid CF4 constrained-realization ensemble that can incorporate explicit Local-Group information and supply independent high-k zoom degrees of freedom without collapsing the CF4 posterior to variants of one parent.

sealed_CF4_parent_bank.posterior: All-data leakage-free BGc linear-Gaussian CF4 constrained-realization bank validated as two-chain homogeneous by the sealed reference audit.
sealed_CF4_parent_bank.parent_proposal: Exactly uniform and stratified over all 256 parents; no parent subset, survivor subset, or result-dependent replication is allowed in the feasibility audit.

hierarchical_target.parent: j is uniform over the sealed empirical CF4 posterior bank.
hierarchical_target.fine_prior: x=z+R*(y_j-Rz), hence R x=y_j exactly and z supplies the independent ker(R) Gaussian degrees of freedom.
hierarchical_target.midpoint_target: Use the unchanged V8 diagonal-normal midpoint prior p(q).
hierarchical_target.midpoint_proposal: Use the unchanged V8 equal-weight defensive mixture g(q); retain exact normalized log p(q)-log g(q).
hierarchical_target.axis: Isotropic unit-vector prior and identical isotropic proposal, so its density ratio cancels.
hierarchical_target.peak_information: The unchanged fourteen Gaussian-smoothed linear-density observations from V8 are explicit Local-Group information, not information attributed to CF4.
hierarchical_target.peak_conditioning_subspace: Condition only in ker(R), using Q=I-R*R. Every conditioned N576 field must still restrict to its original N192 parent.
hierarchical_target.peak_conditional_draw: For A(q,a) and target t, draw x from p(x|y_j,q,a,t) by Matheron correction with covariance Q and the unchanged V8 likelihood sigma.
hierarchical_target.peak_marginal_evidence: Z_peak(j,q,a)=Normal[t; A R* y_j, A Q A* + Sigma]. The determinant and quadratic terms must both be included with normalized Gaussian constants.
hierarchical_target.pre_z0_log_weight: log Z_peak(j,q,a) + log p(q) - log g(q). The uniform parent proposal and isotropic-axis proposal cancel their target densities.
hierarchical_target.post_z0_log_weight: pre_z0_log_weight plus the unchanged normalized V8 log-mean-exp z=0 pair likelihood. Peak evidence may not be dropped after drawing from the peak-conditional proposal.

stage_0_exact_operator_engineering.purpose: Implement Q, the normalized peak evidence, and the Matheron conditional without opening an all-parent result.
required_controls: Small dense-Gaussian comparison of Q=I-R*R, AQA*, log Z_peak, and conditional mean/covariance.
Adjoint identity and positive-semidefinite covariance checks.
Conditioned-field R x=y round-trip check including output-Nyquist modes.
Identical result from direct and cached translated-kernel paths.
Explicit FFT worker limit; workers=-1, process-table polling, and hidden unbounded thread pools are forbidden.
stage_0_exact_operator_engineering.authorization_on_pass: Freeze the all-parent evidence-only feasibility program; do not generate candidates.

stage_1_all_parent_evidence_feasibility.purpose: Determine at low cost whether the unchanged Local-Group peak information leaves enough independent CF4-parent support before any N576 candidate bank or PM forward.
stage_1_all_parent_evidence_feasibility.parent_policy: Use every one of the 256 parents exactly once per common integration draw.

integration.parent_marginal_evidence: log mean exp over the 64 normalized log Z_peak+log p-log g values.

gates.lineage: All 256 parent files and the manifest must rehash exactly; seeds 3193--3448 must appear once per integration draw.
gates.finite_normalized_evidence: All 16384 log-evidence rows and their Gaussian log determinants must be finite.
gates.half_bank_stability: The first and second 32-draw halves must have parent-weight L1 distance <=0.20 and parent ESS relative difference <=0.20.

failure_actions.Monte_Carlo_instability_only: Freeze a new independent integration bank with more draws; do not change physical targets or inspect candidate fields.
failure_actions.parent_support_or_CF4_compatibility: Stop the architecture. Do not tune the peak target or sigma after seeing the result; report tension between the unchanged LG model and the CF4 posterior family.

stage_1_all_parent_evidence_feasibility.authorization_on_pass: Authorize a separately frozen small conditional-field bank with exact parent-stratified weights and round-trip audit; PM remains unauthorized.

later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.conditional_field_bank: At least one prospectively seeded N576 conditional draw per parent, with normalized peak-evidence and midpoint importance weights retained.
later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.pre_PM_gate: Every field restricts to its assigned parent at the projection-contract tolerance; unweighted parent counts remain exactly stratified; weighted parent ESS remains above the frozen threshold.
later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.PM_allocation: Any unequal replication or screening probability must be prospectively specified and included in the importance denominator.
later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.z0_gate: Retain the existing minimum eight jointly eligible realizations, ESS >=8, and maximum normalized weight <=0.25, now using the complete parent+midpoint+peak-evidence+z0 weight.
later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.large_scale_structures: Virgo, Coma, Local Void, Bootes Void, and other CF4-supported structures require separately preregistered z=0 observables and may not be silently used to choose a parent.
later_stage_requirements_not_yet_authori.zoom: Zoom masks, RAMSES levelmin/levelmax, HOP acceptance, and contamination checks remain downstream and unauthorized.

next: Implement and independently unit-test the exact Q-space peak-evidence engine under stage 0; stop before the all-parent evidence run is frozen.
